title: Chroma / FAISS / Qdrant — What it is
description: Retrieval-augmented generation needs somewhere to put embeddings: Chroma is the batteries-included open-source vector DB (pip install chromadb, collections of ids, documents and embeddings, query by vector); FAISS (Meta AI Research) is the legendary C++ similarity-search library with IndexFlatL2 exact search and IVF/HNSW approximate indexes; Qdrant is the Rust-built vector search engine with payload filtering and cloud or self-hosted operation. Together they are the memory layer of local AI. It is made by Chroma / Meta / Qdrant Solutions and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux (Python).
